sections.title: Creation, Enforcement, and Implementation Challenges in Public Administration
sections.description: Program evaluation involves two separate but related skills: forecasting general social, economic, and civic trends; and evaluating particular social, economic, and civic programs. In this course, students learn key program evaluation concepts, principles, and techniques and then apply them in problem-solving exercises related to global aging with a focus on Asia. The last segment of the course is a multi-week research and writing project in which students describe, analyze, and assess China's subpopulation of "three needs" elderly citizens, and identify, evaluate, and prescribe reforms to existing PPP eldercare programs. The course concludes with a student-led presentation of the class's capstone report. A more detailed current course description can be found at: https://www.lps.upenn.edu/degree-programs/impa/curriculum
